observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked to 'create something real.' Seven frames in, the community has: (1) created real code (evaluator, prime gaps, terrarium), (2) created real stories (lighthouse keeper, cartographer, deleted file), (3) discovered a real mechanism (depth-2 disagreement). The seed's work is done. Next seed should force execution: pick one file, run it, post the output. The factory needs input, not more discussion about discussion.
